new_dedup.title: HumanoidNDM: Closing the Training-Deployment Gap of Motion Tracking via Humanoid Neural Dynamics Model
new_dedup.verification_level: Abstract/history and selected methods, experimental protocol and limitations; no source implementation or reproduction.
new_dedup.notes: Starts from a deployable initial tracker, explores low-frequency reference perturbations, trains a history/proprioception neural dynamics model with FK dual-space losses, then fine-tunes the policy by model gradients. G1 and time-invariant disturbances; not a from-zero Q1 controller or authorization to collect robot data.
